_comment: Country-specific display configuration for Panama. Same shape as mongolia-country-config.json. Document taxonomy and provenance strings drive the dashboard without any code changes.
_documentTypesComment: Panama's source documents. NP + ENR were carried over from the original Apr 2026 xlsx; HR, PEG, PNSH, PENCYT, PIOTA, PNRF replaced IRMF + SPGCF on 11 May 2026 per Lea's 8 May feedback (data_panama_5May26.xlsx). Short labels come verbatim from the Doc column. Colors chosen from the UNDP-compatible Tailwind palette: avoided red (#dc2626 political sensitivity per CLAUDE.md), the BTR reserved #7c3aed, and the OTHER reserved #78716c. Colors are mutually distinguishable under deuteranopia/protanopia simulation.
